name: scroll-spy-table-of-contents
title: Scroll Spy Table of Contents
description: An article outline sidebar highlighting active document section based on viewport intersection position.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Viewport Intersection Highlighting: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
